# Questions

## Part 1
```{r}
?midwest
```
### Question 1
```{r}
midwest |>
  count(state, name = "n_counties") |>
  arrange(desc(n_counties))
```
State with the highest number of counties is Illinois with 102 counties, while state with the lowest number of counties is Wisconsin with 72 counties.
\newpage
### Question 2
```{r}
midwest |>
  count(county, name = "n_states") |>
  filter(n_states == 5) |>
  arrange(desc(n_states))
```
Counties with the names Crawford, Jackson and Monroe appear in all five states 
in the dataset.
